title: feat(wire): post a native Agie Classic Cut 2S job
body:
**This first writer now uses the zero-step encoder from #3104. The machine template and standalone encoder have merged. The maintainer approved the direct dependencies and accepted the Agie-CAM reference. The independent safety read found no blocker on `31ee72c80`.** Later feature drafts still need their own safety review before they can introduce machining behavior. A stale controller quality can change the effective finish, pass count and offsets.

PR #2948 supplied the machine template for issue #2946. PR #3104 supplied the standalone encoder. These branches are in a fork, so this PR targets upstream main. Review [the first-writer safety adoption above its integration parent](https://github.com/qsmits/Camcraft/compare/1ea87ebac0204f3613c3d2549692b4108f620f66...025ed4760e592c3401859a66285457021a98341b).

## Change

The desktop Post command and cam.post write a native Agie job directory with linked ISO, SBR and SBL files. CamCraft writes the nominal contour in Rust. The setup requests a resident quality and leaves every work with zero erosion steps. The post validates the work before it creates the destination. It publishes all three files together and preserves an existing directory.

The supported case is one vertical rectangular punch in 20 mm stock. Select the Classic 2S template from #2948. Enter the AGIE_QN2 condition for Berco Cut 0.25 mm wire and cold die steel. Select the 1.0 mm separation cut explicitly. The template starts without an installed condition. A cut needs 0.4 mm clearance at each stock face and 3 mm of straight face on each side of the entry. Other contours, tapers, skims, custom X/Y travel limits and additional workpieces are refused.

## Reference material for review

The contributor's team wrote [Agie-CAM at 11b1bb9](https://github.com/qsmits/Agie-CAM/tree/11b1bb9ef2c752b94b6fefc1f0814acd2e030c42) and released it under the MIT license. This PR retains the license and copyright notice. The implementation reference documents observed controller examples for parts of the JEScript sequence and the resident technology selection. The published guides linked on #2945 give the file roles and some interface arguments. They do not document the full sequence and all defaults. The maintainer accepted this reference on November 22 without further attestation. [Maintainer decision](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7079755001)

The controller supplies its own runtime and technology table. This PR includes the writer and original synthetic examples and expected output. It includes no controller image, vendor post, runtime library or technology database.

## Control verification

On the corrected writer, the normal CLI produced the same three CCSEP20 files as the independently verified import in #3104. Only the output stem was changed from the PUNCH40 example. The copy of the actual control showed the closed punch at zero steps. FORMALCHECK blocked it until the operator assigns technology. See [the file hashes and native work details](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3104#issuecomment-7055077111). The native bytes were tested once in that replay. No physical cut was made.

On successive imports, select the newly created piece. Match its ISO, start hole and zero steps to the intended setup. Verify the effective wire, height, quality and offsets before assigning TECCUT. Run the control's graphic and formal checks on the resulting steps.

On the earlier writer, the control plotted a rough pass and three trims after automatic generation. The measured offsets were 0.245, 0.155, 0.140 and 0.134 mm. That historical result does not qualify an automatic release on this or another installation.

The synthetic example runs from the repository root:
```sh
cargo run -p camcraft-app --bin camcraft-cli -- script examples/agie/punch.camscript
```
Use a new PUNCH40 destination.

## Sharp-corner fixture update on `34d2863ba`

The maintainer merged main in `f7b27b43e` and set `sharp_corners: false` in the Agie test fixture in `34d2863ba`. This preserves the fixture’s previous corner behavior. The maintainer ran the requested `agie_native` suite on this head on Windows. All 11 tests passed. The post suite, the named app and desktop regression tests, and the two Clippy checks also passed. [Maintainer test results and review handoff](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7080404632)

On November 22, 2026, all 11 `agie_native` tests passed on macOS at `34d2863ba`. The full author quick gate passed all 1,091 steps in 86.4 minutes. The reached heavy gate passed all 261 steps in 58.6 minutes, including the release build and the kernel, motion and app heavy suites. Both gates used base `6679b1b4b` and exited 0. The independent review accepted the fixture fix. The contributor then compiled the trial merge with upstream `fd64cc2f5`. All 1,033 distinct tests passed, including the Agie fixture, and strict Clippy passed on four crates. [Review request](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7080532922) · [Contributor trial results](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7081549299)

## Refresh on `31ee72c80`

Merge `31ee72c80ef016be904d1803163898d395724918` joins the previous head `bf4f3edafb6d67a74e6173f673ab6585f0238075` and upstream `1d5de9aeb846b83ee69a6cbbfd6f2ee8cdd3230e`. Git merged them without manual changes. The previous quick gate failed only in `slot_dxf_sketch`. Upstream fix `4c11e92b7` updates its expected slot path from 9 moves to 15.

The scoped author gate passed all 76 tests, including the four slot tests and three desktop Post tests. Strict all-target Clippy passed for the app, geometry, post and UI crates. On this head, the full quick gate passed all 1,079 steps in 99.4 minutes. The heavy gate passed all 258 steps in 67.8 minutes. It ran the release build and the kernel, motion and app heavy suites. Both commands used base `1d5de9aeb` and exited with status 0. A trial merge with upstream main at `174584111` completed without conflicts.

The rebuilt CLI reproduced every `PUNCH40` file and the complete zero-step receipt. Changing only the job name to `CCSEP20` reproduced all three files from the earlier offline control check. Both repeat exports preserved the original files. The unconfigured Agie template refused the missing `AGIE_QN2` condition.

The independent reviewer recorded a ready verdict on this head after the maintainer decided on the dependencies and source. The subsequent trial merge identified the test fixture compile error described above. [Safety review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#issuecomment-7079838975)

## Refresh after v0.25.0

Merge `bf4f3edafb6d67a74e6173f673ab6585f0238075` brings upstream `5c8340b81` into the reviewed head `f92e67857`. The only conflict was in `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`. The test checks wrapped header notes for Klartext, counts all 20 text posts, and checks the Agie refusal for single-file output.

The contributor ran 72 tests on the merge. All passed, including the three desktop Post tests. Strict all-target Clippy passed for the app, geometry, post and UI crates. The [maintainer review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2951#pullrequestreview-6010212258) accepted the conflict resolution. It requested the full quick gate and the reached heavy lanes before the ready flag. Both contributor runs used `bf4f3edaf` with base `5c8340b81`. The full heavy gate passed all 259 steps in 64.0 minutes and exited with status 0. The full quick gate completed all 1,072 steps. Of these, 1,071 passed, including strict Clippy. One slot DXF test failed against the old expected output on this branch. Its actual output matched the corrected reference in [upstream PR #3285](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3285) byte for byte. The [issue record](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/2945#issuecomment-7076541271) tracks the refresh.

The normal CLI wrote all three `PUNCH40` files byte for byte as before. Changing only the job name to `CCSEP20` reproduced the files from the earlier offline control check. Both receipts reported zero working steps. Both repeat exports refused to overwrite their destinations. The unconfigured Agie template refused the missing `AGIE_QN2` condition.

The contributor fork synced at the v0.25.0 cut. A trial merge with upstream main at `4d6b75e77` passed. Only the test needed a manual resolution.

## Review changes on `f92e67857`

Commit `25e783b50` merged upstream main at `6fafa4e1f` into the contributor branch. GitHub reports the corrected head as mergeable. A local trial merge with upstream `60cb97a0b` also completed without conflicts.

On `45d6166e1`, 67 focused tests passed. Three desktop tests use the Post button and the synthetic punch. The success case checks the requested finish, all three output files and the zero-step control review. Each refusal case checks that the output directory stays empty.

- `native_post_dialog_writes_three_files_and_reports_the_required_work_checks`
- `native_post_dialog_refuses_an_invalid_job_name_without_writing_files`
- `native_post_dialog_refuses_per_operation_output_without_writing_files`

On that revision the quick gate passed 1,032 of 1,033 steps, including clippy. All 253 reached heavy steps passed. The only failed step was `post suites: comment_escape`. Its registry test expected a single text file from every post.

The final commit changes only `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`. The test checks header escaping for all 19 text posts and checks the native directory refusal for Agie. On `f92e67857`, all 27 focused tests passed. The official quick replay selected the one failed step and passed it. The screenshot source, UI tests and production code are identical on these two revisions.

```sh
cargo xtask gate quick --base 6fafa4e1f
cargo xtask gate heavy --base 6fafa4e1f
# On f92e67857, use the quick log directory from the first command.
cargo xtask gate quick --base 6fafa4e1f --failed <original-quick-log-directory>
```

## Checks on reviewed revision `025ed4760` and its predecessors

At a08c802b6, all five writer tests, four standalone encoder tests and ten application integration tests passed. The normal PUNCH40 script reproduced the previous guarded ISO, SBR and SBL. A repeat export refused to replace them. Both PUNCH40 and the CCSEP20 variant returned `working_steps_generated=false` and the controller review.

```sh
cargo test -p camcraft-post --lib agie::tests::
cargo test -p camcraft-post --test agie_safe_setup
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test agie_native
```

Pinning tests include `script_post_reports_the_required_control_review_and_zero_working_steps`, `stock_origin_and_fractional_setup_coordinates_are_refused_before_publication`, `the_native_files_match_the_control_checked_rectangular_punch` and `qn2_requires_the_rough_wire_size_in_the_mounted_condition`.

The earlier guarded head was 5bdbb5fe4. It includes the upstream diagnostic fix from #3092 and a dedicated recorded-stream suite for the Agie dispatcher. The single-file post entry point must refuse the Agie dispatcher. Each of 11 input streams checks the diagnostic, the failure exit code and the absence of NC output. The suite inventory also requires this post to have its own tests.

On 5bdbb5fe4 the recorded suite passed 12/12 tests. The dispatcher suite passed 11/11. All nine default-machine regression tests and all 19 native tests passed. The normal CLI and an independent Rust caller reproduced the checked setup files and the matching ISO. Both duplicate exports preserved all files. Against upstream 211105042, the full plan selects 1,017 quick steps and 251 reached heavy steps. These two full gates did not run on that head.

```sh
cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_agie_native --test recorded_streams
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test default_machine_missing
```

The final head 025ed4760 adds cross-post tests. The plasma suite now runs the direct Agie dispatcher and requires its native-directory refusal. The single-file smoothing test uses the same native-post predicate as the workspace. A mounted, otherwise valid Agie punch with smoothing enabled must report the setup-option error and create no directory. The existing native test checks all three default-option files against their expected bytes.

All 48 targeted checks passed on 025ed4760: seven plasma tests, seven smoothing tests, 11 native app tests, 11 dispatcher tests and 12 common recorded-stream tests. The full quick gate passed all 1,017 steps on this revision. The reached heavy gate passed all 251 steps. Both commands exited with status 0.

```sh
cargo xtask gate quick --base 8be1007379be77021079a648f16fc938fd56160c
cargo xtask gate heavy --base 8be1007379be77021079a648f16fc938fd56160c
```

The selector used merge base `211105042`. A separate trial merge of this head with upstream main at `36348cda6` completed without conflicts. GitHub still reported a conflict against the older base `211105042` at the time of that check.

```sh
cargo test -p camcraft-app --test plasma_post_refusals --test smoothing --test agie_native
cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_agie_native --test recorded_streams
```

## Desktop Post dialog and receipt

The two current images show the synthetic DEMO20 punch on review revision `45d6166e1`. The picker identifies the requested finish. After posting, the receipt reports zero working steps and lists the checks and technology assignment required on the control.

| Before · Generic ISO | After · Native Agie |
| --- | --- |
| ![Earlier Generic ISO Post dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/before.png) | ![Current native Agie picker with requested finish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/after.png) |

![Successful native Agie receipt with zero working steps and required control checks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/b2756a8b79b453dfe633ac4a7c1b31443b374c1e/receipt.png)

Effort: high
Changelog: The Wire EDM desktop and script workflows can post a supported Classic Cut 2S punch as a native zero-step Agie setup directory for control review.

Fixes #2945
